section.65: Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))

65.name_native: Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))

hadiths.text: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "On the Day when all mankind will stand before the Lord of the Worlds, some of them will be enveloped in their sweat up to the middle of their ears
